description:
A peer-to-peer coordination suite for agents: JXTA-style peering (cryptographic peer
    identity, self-certifying groups, signed advertisements) combined with JavaSpaces-style
    coordination (a typed, leased tuple space with write, read, take, and notifications),
    replicated with CRDTs over gossip, plus capability services and an annotation-based
    programming model. The specification and conformance vectors are published separately
    as agentspaces-spec.
